meta.name: frontend-design
meta.description: Guidance for distinctive, intentional visual design when building new UI or reshaping an existing one. Helps with aesthetic direction, typography, and making choices that don't read as templated defaults.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 打造有辨识度的界面视觉风格
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你正在设计新界面或优化现有视觉风格
copy.tagline_en: Craft distinctive visual styles for your UI
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are designing a new UI or refining an existing visual style

howto.what: 装上这个技能后，Claude 会像一位设计主管，提供独特的视觉方向，包括配色、字体、布局，并承担一个合理的美学风险。它还会生成设计计划、代码，并自我检查是否模板化。
howto.when: 当你要求设计新的用户界面或重新设计现有界面时触发，尤其是当你强调需要独特、非模板化的视觉效果时。

say.text: 帮我设计一个登录页，要显得独特。
say.note: Claude 会生成一个带有独特视觉风格的设计方案。

say.text: 给这个博客页面一个独特的视觉风格。
say.note: Claude 会分析内容并创建专属于该博客的配色和字体。

say.text: 为这个产品页面选一套配色和字体。
say.note: Claude 会提供具体的设计建议并说明理由。

howto.what_en: After installing this skill, Claude acts as a design lead, providing distinctive visual direction including palette, typography, layout, and one justified aesthetic risk. It produces a design plan, code, and self-critiques to avoid template defaults.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to design a new UI or redesign an existing one, especially when you emphasize unique, non-templated visuals.

say_en.text: Design a login page that looks distinctive.
say_en.note: Claude will generate a design with a unique visual style.

say_en.text: Give this blog page a unique visual style.
say_en.note: Claude will analyze the content and create custom colors and fonts.

say_en.text: Choose a color palette and typography for this product page.
say_en.note: Claude will provide specific design recommendations with rationale.
